result.title: Para-Gaussian Approximations of Random Deep Neural Networks
result.summary: It is known that randomly initialized neural networks have Gaussian behaviour in the $n\to \infty$ limit. Unfortunately, this approximation can be poor for finite $n$ and gets worse as one goes deeper into the network. In this work, we develop a more accurate approximation that is \emph{slightly} non-Gaussian, which we call the para-Gaussian distribution and is constructed from the Hermite polynomials. We show how this para-Gaussian approximation can lead to a practical recursive method to approximate the deeper layers of the network. Finally, we apply this theory to linear neural networks (where things can be solved exactly) and to ReLU neural networks (where things can be approximated).

AI.brief_summary: 该论文研究随机初始化深层网络的分布近似：用 Hermite 多项式构造「para-Gaussian」分布，对有限宽度、深层网络给出比高斯近似更准确的递归近似，并在线性网络与 ReLU 网络上验证。
